outcome_detail: Civil claim filed February 2023 in B.C. seeking general, aggravated and special damages plus lost earnings; dedicated searches found no reported settlement, judgment or dismissal as of July 2026. A related union grievance against the VPD (filed May 2021) resulted in a $30,000 CAD labour-arbitration award to the plaintiff, decision dated September 26, 2025.
criminal_detail: Jagraj Roger Berar was convicted in 2021 of sexually assaulting his fellow VPD officer (2019 incident in Whistler, B.C.) and sentenced to one year in jail (sentencing reported in 2021 by Global News and in 2022 by The Canadian Press); he was ordered to provide a DNA sample and placed on the provincial sex offender registry for 10 years.
incident_date_approx: 2019 (sexual assault at a social gathering in Whistler, B.C.); alleged workplace harassment and group-chat targeting of the victim from 2019 onward
description: A female Vancouver Police Department officer filed a civil claim in February 2023 against Jagraj Roger Berar, a former VPD constable and colleague, over a 2019 sexual assault at a social gathering in Whistler, B.C. Berar was criminally convicted of the sexual assault in 2021 and sentenced to one year in jail. According to the claim, the plaintiff suffered post-traumatic stress, anxiety, depression and emotional anguish, and she seeks general, aggravated and special damages and compensation for lost earnings. In a related proceeding, a union grievance filed in May 2021 alleged the department mishandled her sexual harassment and discrimination complaints after the assault, including derogatory commentary about her court testimony shared in an officers' WhatsApp group chat; a labour arbitrator awarded her $30,000 against the VPD in a decision dated September 26, 2025. A Police Act disciplinary investigation found a former VPD sergeant committed discreditable conduct by sharing the group-chat commentary.
notes: Civil defendant is the individual former officer, not the agency; the related union grievance and arbitration award targeted the Vancouver Police Department. Related Police Act disciplinary findings (November 2024) over the group-chat conduct.
